data.title: Passo
data.about:
Introducing Passo, an architectural masterpiece located on the crescent of Palm Jumeirah. Developed by Beyond, this iconic project comprises two sculptural towers, Avita and Bella, home to a limited collection of 625 residences. The development features a mix of 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, 4 to 5-bedroom penthouses, and luxurious 6-bedroom beachfront mansions, all meticulously designed to blend seamless contemporary living with coastal serenity.

Passo by Beyond Developments is not just a residence; it's a lifestyle. Set against a backdrop of uninterrupted sea and skyline views, the project redefines beachfront living. Its curated offerings include pools, a wellness pavilion, a social club, and wet lounges, providing an exceptional blend of leisure, wellness, and sophistication. With high ROI potential, resort-inspired amenities, and an attractive payment structure, Passo by Beyond is a prime choice for discerning investors and lifestyle seekers alike.

characteristics_module.title: Passo by Beyond at Palm Jumeirah: A Lifestyle Immersed in Waterfront Elegance
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Beachfront living - Beach access and panoramic sea views define life at Passo’s exclusive shoreline location
  • Seamless connectivity - Ideally located on the Palm Crescent with direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road and city landmarks
  • Luxury amenities - Enjoy resort-style features such as wellness pavilions, wet lounges, pools, and social decks
  • Developed by Beyond – A visionary developer established by Omniyat Group, known for architectural excellence and holistic, nature-inspired design
  • Strong ROI potential - Located in Dubai’s most sought-after neighborhood with limited, high-value inventory
  • Flexible payment plan - The 60/40 payment plan offers structured ease with 10% on booking and 40% on completion
  • Attractive starting price - Premium luxury begins with a starting price AED 4.1M offering unmatched value
  • Architectural statement - Inspired by nature and sculpted by the sea with flowing facades and elevated aesthetics

location_tile.title: Unrivalled Palm Jumeirah Prestige
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Passo enjoys an exclusive address on the crescent of Palm Jumeirah, surrounded by the Arabian Gulf and city skyline. The location provides ultimate privacy while being conveniently close to major destinations including Sheikh Zayed Road. Enjoy proximity to Dubai’s top landmarks, entertainment hubs, and international airports.

  • 4 Minutes – Atlantis The Royal
  • 12 Minutes – Nakheel Mall
  • 13 Minutes – Dubai Marina
  • 12 Minutes – Downtown Dubai/Burj Khalifa
  • 35 Minutes – Dubai International Airport (DXB)
  • 35 Minutes – Al Maktoum International Airport (DWC)
